Nivel de vechime: Asociat
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Who We Are
 For one of our clients, we are looking for an experienced Software Developer with strong Delphi knowledge and Java 17 skills to join a team responsible for the development and modernization of applications in the area of Dienstreisemanagement (Business Travel Management).
The position is part of the broader EMS – Employer and Employee Services organization, which develops applications and services for employers and employees, with a strong focus on HR-related processes.
 What You’ll Be Doing
Develop, maintain and enhance existing applications written in Delphi
Contribute to the modernization and migration of legacy functionality towards Java 17
Analyze existing legacy code and business logic
Design and implement new application features
Support the replacement of the legacy application
Participate in implementation and integration projects
Collaborate closely with developers, architects, product owners and business stakeholders
Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues in existing applications
Ensure code quality, maintainability and technical documentation
Contribute to technical discussions regarding the future application architecture
 What We’re Looking For
Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field
At least 4y+ of experience in working with Java 17
Strong professional experience with Delphi
Ability to understand and work with existing / legacy application architectures
Experience in software development, maintenance and application modernization
German language skills – required for communication within the project and team
 Nice To Have
Experience with migration or modernization of legacy applications
Experience working in enterprise application environments
Knowledge of HR, payroll, travel management or related business processes
Experience with application integration and APIs
Familiarity with modern Java frameworks and development practices
